summary.text: Yolonda Fountain-Henderson, listed by Ballotpedia as Yolonda Fountain Henderson, is a Democratic state representative from Missouri House of Representatives District 85, an office she has held since January 2023, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia says she previously served as mayor and city councilwoman of Jennings and on the Jennings School Board.

paragraphs.text: Yolonda Fountain-Henderson was born in St. Louis, Missouri, and lives there.
Ballotpedia says she graduated from Jennings Senior High School and North County Technical High School and earned a degree in accounting from Hickey Business College.

It says she served as mayor of and city councilwoman for the City of Jennings, and on the Jennings School Board, the Missouri School Board Association and the National School Board Association, and that she began volunteering with the Urban League.
Fountain-Henderson assumed office in the Missouri House on January 4, 2023, succeeding Kevin Windham Jr., and is also listed as an officeholder of the Jennings School District, At-large.
Her 2025-2026 committee assignments are the Corrections and Public Institutions Committee and the Transportation Committee.
